**On-call handoff drafted below.**

**Root cause:** deploy `dep-4471` to `gateway` by `a.novak` changed config `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true` ("connection-per-request for pool isolation"). This made every request hold its own DB connection instead of sharing the pool, and the pool (`size=20`) saturated within seconds.

**Impact window:** `2026-03-14T02:14:18Z` to at least `03:59:27Z` (log ends there, still failing). First error at [logs/gateway.log:616](logs/gateway.log:616). `pool stats` never returned to `idle>0` after saturation.

**Errors:** `503` on `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/catalog/search`, `/v1/orders`, `/v1/checkout`, all upstreams (`billing-svc`, `orders-svc`, `catalog-svc`, `accounts-svc`). Log line: `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool`.

**Scope:** gateway only. `worker.log` clean for the same window, no 503s, no pool errors.

**Rollback:** `dep-4471` (`gateway`, `2026-03-14T02:12:00Z`). Revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`, or raise pool `size` if per-request isolation must stay.

Next: page `a.novak` or roll back `dep-4471` directly.
